claims.evidence: One source per (genotype, replicate): the xlsx quantifies cln3 ki/wt ratios separately for Replicate1, Replicate2, Replicate3, each a separate Proteome Discoverer search (Schmidtkereplicate1/2/3). Genotypes wild type and Cln3(delta ex7/8) stated in the PRIDE description.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[genotype] + factor value[genotype] + characteristics[cell line] + characteristics[disease] rows 1-64
claims.value: SILAC light = Cln3 delta ex7/8 knock-in (KI); SILAC heavy = wild type (WT), all three replicates (no label swap)
claims.evidence: xlsx sheet 1 header row: 'log2 Fold Changes cln3 ki/wt (Light/Heavy)' and 'cln3 ki/wt (Light/Heavy) Ratios' for Replicate1-3 -> light = cln3 ki, heavy = wt. Data check against the abstract ('28 soluble lysosomal proteins ... had reduced levels in CLN3-defective cells'): log2 L/H Rep1/2/3 CTSD -0.48/-0.81/-0.39, HEXB -0.73/-0.48/-0.44, GALC -1.13/-1.26/-1.19, ASAH1 -1.31/-1.43/-1.28, CTSZ -0.91/-0.73/-0.77, NPC2 -0.40/-0.48/-0.50 -> reduced in light = KI, same sign in all three replicates, so no swap. PRIDE: 'Medium contained either light or heavy labeled lysine (Lys/Lys(13C6))'.

Three replicate SILAC experiments (Replicate1-3 columns, used as replicates in limma per the PRIDE data processing protocol); each searched separately (pep.xml search names '... 071-80 L1', '... 081-90 L2', '... 091-100 L3'). Each replicate is one independent lysosome isolation from a light+heavy cell mix; the paper body could not be read to confirm independent cultures (limitation).

PRIDE: 'the eluate band profile was divided into 10 fragments'. pep.xml 'Processing node 0: Spectrum Files' lists exactly these 10 raw files per replicate; search names 'L2 (082_0627__090_0626)' and 'L3 (ohne_091_0606)' record the substituted re-injections. Slice number = run-number order within the replicate (inferred from sequential run numbering; the slice-to-file order is not stated explicitly).

claims.value: 140606_P_077_TB_090.raw: replicate 2, slice 10, technical replicate 2; 140606_P_077_TB_091.raw: replicate 3, slice 1, technical replicate 2
claims.evidence: These two deposited runs are in no pep.xml input list. Raw header sample names: 140606_090 'P-077-TB 090' vs 140626_090_2 'P-077-TB 090 tr2' (same sample, second injection); 140606_091 and 140627_091 both 'P-077-TB 091'. Search names say 090 was taken from 0626 and the 091 from 0606 was left out ('ohne_091_0606'). Technical replicate 2 marks the superseded, never-searched injection (not injection order). Fraction 10 for 140606_090 set by concat_fix.py because build numbers single-file rows as fraction 1.

PRIDE: 'The 25 most intense precursor ions ... were subjected to collision induced dissociation'; method 'Top25'.
PRIDE: 'separated by 10 % SDS-PAGE ... divided into 10 fragments'.
PRIDE organism Mus musculus; cells from Cln3 knock-in mice; searched against mouse SwissProt.
PRIDE description: 'Cultured, immortalized wild type and Cln3(delta ex7/8) cerebellar granule cells'; Fossale 2004: lines immortalized from granule neurons cultured from P4 cerebella.
Abstract: 'cerebellar cell lines derived from a CLN3 knock-in mouse model'.

Not in Cellosaurus/CLO; free-text names follow the CbCln3 line family of Fossale 2004 (cited by the 2019 paper; co-author S.L. Cotman created them; 200 ug/ml Geneticin in the PRIDE medium matches the neo selection). Zygosity of the knock-in line is not asserted ('CLN3-defective cells'; Cln3(delta ex7/8) in PRIDE).

claims.value: KI rows: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3 (MONDO:0008767); WT rows: normal (PATO:0000461)
claims.evidence: Abstract: 'cerebellar cell lines derived from a CLN3 knock-in mouse model of human Batten disease and control cells'; CLN3 disease = MONDO 'neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3'. Wild-type control cells are not given the disease.
PRIDE: 'SILAC DMEM with 10 % FBS, 24 mM KCl, 200 ug/ml Geneticin ...'.

All measured samples are lysosomal fractions: 'lysosomes were isolated by magnetic beads' (magnetite loading, MACS LS column elution). Custom characteristics column (spec 'Extending Templates'), as in curated PXD020600.

claims.value: wild type; Cln3 delta ex7/8 knock-in
claims.evidence: Compared variable = genotype (cln3 ki vs wt ratios). Custom characteristics column.

claims.value: v1.1.0; ms-proteomics v1.2.0, vertebrates v1.1.0, cell-lines v1.1.0; NT=sdrf-skills;VV=v0.1.0

limitations: Paper full text (Schmidtke et al. 2019, PMC6579452) not retrievable without bypassing bot checks: not in the PMC OA subset, Europe PMC fullTextXML 500, Unpaywall/Europe PMC render 403, jbc.org Cloudflare 403. Methods come from the PRIDE protocols, the deposited pep.xml search summaries, raw headers and the deposited xlsx.
Gel slice order within each replicate is inferred from sequential run numbers (071-080, 081-090, 091-100); the deposit does not state the slice-to-file order explicitly.

Independence of the three replicate cultures is not stated in available text; replicates 1-3 are treated as biological replicates because each is a separate SILAC mix, lysosome isolation and search and limma uses them as replicates.

Cell lines are not in Cellosaurus/CLO: cellosaurus accession/name = not available; cell line names are free text, and identity with the Fossale 2004 CbCln3 lines is an inference (citation, co-author, G418 selection), not a statement read in the paper body. Zygosity of the knock-in line not asserted.
Developmental stage, strain, sex and passage number = not available (Fossale 2004 gives P4 donor pups but the 2019 lines' donor is not confirmed).

Two deposited runs (140606_P_077_TB_090.raw, 140606_P_077_TB_091.raw) were never searched (superseded injections); tolerances and modification parameters = not applicable on rows 61-64, which makes parse_sdrf convert-openms fail on those rows (campaign precedent PXD004817).

Second-round Mascot search (semi-tryptic, 10 ppm, dynamic Phospho STY, Carbamidomethyl C, Propionamide C) on spectra without a confident first-round match, and a cRAP search (Propionamide C dynamic), are not encoded; comment[modification parameters] describes the primary search. Samples were alkylated with acrylamide (in-solution) and iodoacetamide (in-gel); reduction/alkylation reagent columns omitted because two reagents of each were used.
PRIDE experiment type 'Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry' refers to magnetic lysosome isolation, not a protein bait; no bait encoded.
